condition.narrative: Before the first Disbursement of Grant funding for NaMATA under the ITP Project, the Accountable Entity must develop and adopt an implementing entity agreement with NaMATA, in form and substance satisfactory to MCC.

Before the first Disbursement of Grant funding for the ITP Project, the Government shall deliver to MCC evidence, in each case, in form and substance satisfactory to MCC, that: NaMATA has allocated appropriate working space within its offices for the consultants performing any technical assistance under the Project.

Before the first Disbursement of Grant funding for the ITP Project, the Government shall deliver to MCC evidence, in each case, in form and substance satisfactory to MCC, that: NaMATA has been duly authorized to initiate the recruitment and hiring of permanent staff in accordance with its existing staffing plan.

Before the first Disbursement of Grant funding for the ITP Project, the Government shall deliver to MCC evidence, in each case, in form and substance satisfactory to MCC, that: the National Assembly has approved, and NaMATA has received, an administrative budget to support the recruitment and hiring of permanent staff within its Transport Planning Department, in accordance with its existing staffing plan.

Before the first Disbursement of Grant funding for the ITP Project, the Government shall deliver to MCC evidence, in each case, in form and substance satisfactory to MCC, that: a. the Government has created or designated NaMATA as a sub-program within the budget for Urban and Metropolitan Development.
Further details on conditions precedent affecting this activity can be found in the top-level parent activities.
